subject: POC Observability Plan - FintechX (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC Observability Plan - FintechX (next steps)

Hi Emily and Rajiv,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and glad the FintechX team is excited to move forward with a short POC to validate latency, cost per request, and end-to-end telemetry integration. Per our call, I'm capturing the capture the observability items we discussed and proposing owners/timelines so we can lock the success criteria and evaluation plan.

High-level POC scope (2 weeks):
- Run Redwood inference on a dedicated test model for 2M tokens of traffic from your staging workload
- Validate latency SLOs (p95 < 250ms) and throughput target (>= 30 reqs/s)
- Verify end-to-end tracing and log export into your Splunk instance
- Confirm cost metrics and per-route token breakdown in Redwood Console

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Observability: Traces for cold/warm starts captured, spans show service latency, and traces tie back to request IDs in FintechX logs.
2) Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens per request, cost per 1k tokens; dashboard alerts for error rate > 1% and tail latency spikes.
3) Export: Logs and metrics exported to your Splunk (or S3) with retention as defined by your security team.
4) Ownership: Redwood => instrumentation + Console dashboards; FintechX => trace ingestion, access to staging API traffic.

Attached is a short POC_Observability_Template.xlsx with proposed dashboards and fields to fill; it includes sample alert thresholds. Can you and Rajiv review and indicate any gaps?

Next steps:
- Emily: confirm success criteria and owner for Splunk ingestion by Tue 5/18
- Rajiv: share sample staging traffic and credentials for a read-only S3 dump by Wed 5/19
- Jordan/Marcus: we'll schedule a short infra sync to set up tracing and log forwarding (30 min)

If this looks good I'll send a formal mutual action plan and calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: POC_Observability_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>

Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechx.com>, FintechX Security <security@fintechx.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan - FintechX (next steps)

Hi Marissa, thanks for the recap and the template. Quick answers inline: 

- Success criteria: Agree with the list. Add: we need request sampling at 5% for privacy and cost control.
- Dashboards: We want a single observability dashboard in Splunk that shows p50/p95/p99, error rate, token counts, and per-model cost.
- Ownership: FintechX will own Splunk ingestion and masking (security team), Redwood will provide tracer spans and Console dashboards.

Rajiv is assigning an engineer to prepare a staging traffic dump; we'll target Wed 5/19 EOD.

One ask from Security: can Redwood provide a short note on what metadata is included in traces (PII check)? I've cc'd security.

Emily
Head of Engineering
FintechX

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan - FintechX (next steps)

Emily, thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers to security question below (more formal note to follow):
- Traces: Redwood tracer includes request_id, model_name, token_count, timing spans for queue/exec/serialize. No customer PII is sent by default; payloads are not included in traces.
- Logs: We can redact client-provided fields if you provide a list of sensitive keys; default logs include status codes, latencies, and error messages.
- Export: We support pushing metrics via Prometheus remote write and logs via a forwarder to S3/Splunk.

I've also attached a quick mockup of the proposed Console dashboard (obs-dash-mockup.png) so you can see the widgets I mentioned on the call (latency histogram, per-route cost, trace waterfall).

Proposed schedule:
- Thu 5/20: infra sync (30 min) — Jordan will send invite
- Wed 5/26: Redwood finishes integration and initial dashboard, FintechX runs verification test by EOD
- Fri 5/28: Joint review and signoff

If that timeline works I'll start instrumenting the test model this week.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
